notes: Blocks F, G, H load into evsm-svg-v3.html via Setup → Extra Items. Scales agree4 and free render today; proposedScale 'pick' (roster) and 'count' (number) are tool additions and fall back to free text until added.

items.text: **In the last three months, which neighborhood groups, projects or initiatives did you actually work with — not just hear about?** _List them, one per line, using the names on the roster where you can._
items.help: Working with means you did something together: a meeting you both attended for a purpose, a task you shared, a hand-off. Hearing about them or reading their posts does not count.
items.blockHelp: Two questions about who you actually work with. Names are used only to draw the network; the report shows counts and shapes, never who named whom. In anonymous mode the names are replaced by codes before anything is stored.
items.derives: Density among active groups → S-1; your number of ties → S-2; components → fragmentation

items.text: **If something went wrong on your block tomorrow — a flood, an eviction notice, a fight — who would you go to first?** _Name up to three people or groups._
items.help: Answer with who you would really go to, not who you think you should. A group name is fine if that is how you would reach them.
items.blockHelp: Two questions about who you actually work with. Names are used only to draw the network; the report shows counts and shapes, never who named whom. In anonymous mode the names are replaced by codes before anything is stored.
items.derives: In-degree concentration → S-10 (who is turned to, and how many); share of respondents naming anyone → S-4 reach; reciprocity → S-11

items.text: **Joint activities.** _How many activities in the last three months were carried out by two or more neighborhood groups together?_
items.blockHelp: Eleven counts, one per sphere, for the last three months, answered once per wave by the person who keeps the center's records — not by every resident. Each is the observed side of a sphere the survey otherwise measures only as belief. Enter whole numbers; where two numbers are asked for, enter both.
items.gaming: Counting every meeting as joint; define joint as shared work, not shared attendance.

items.text: **Distinct people active.** _How many different people took part in at least one neighborhood activity in the last three months?_
items.blockHelp: Eleven counts, one per sphere, for the last three months, answered once per wave by the person who keeps the center's records — not by every resident. Each is the observed side of a sphere the survey otherwise measures only as belief. Enter whole numbers; where two numbers are asked for, enter both.
items.gaming: Inflated by one-off attendees; report also the number active on 2+ occasions.

items.text: **Uses of shared space and tools.** _How many bookings or uses of the neighborhood's shared spaces, vehicles and tools were there?_
items.blockHelp: Eleven counts, one per sphere, for the last three months, answered once per wave by the person who keeps the center's records — not by every resident. Each is the observed side of a sphere the survey otherwise measures only as belief. Enter whole numbers; where two numbers are asked for, enter both.
items.gaming: Low count may mean no log, not no use; note whether a log exists.

items.text: **Blocks with a contact.** _How many blocks (or buildings) have a named contact person the center can reach? Out of how many?_
items.blockHelp: Eleven counts, one per sphere, for the last three months, answered once per wave by the person who keeps the center's records — not by every resident. Each is the observed side of a sphere the survey otherwise measures only as belief. Enter whole numbers; where two numbers are asked for, enter both.
items.gaming: Stale contacts; count only those reached in the last year.

items.text: **Changes after review.** _How many decisions or practices were changed because of a review, after-action or A3 in the last three months?_
items.blockHelp: Eleven counts, one per sphere, for the last three months, answered once per wave by the person who keeps the center's records — not by every resident. Each is the observed side of a sphere the survey otherwise measures only as belief. Enter whole numbers; where two numbers are asked for, enter both.
items.gaming: Reviews with no change are not counted; that is the point.

items.text: **Commitments kept.** _How many commitments were made in the last three months, and how many were completed?_
items.blockHelp: Eleven counts, one per sphere, for the last three months, answered once per wave by the person who keeps the center's records — not by every resident. items.text: **Money and runway.** _Money in, money out, in the last three months — and months of runway at the current rate?_
items.blockHelp: Eleven counts, one per sphere, for the last three months, answered once per wave by the person who keeps the center's records — not by every resident. Each is the observed side of a sphere the survey otherwise measures only as belief. Enter whole numbers; where two numbers are asked for, enter both.
items.gaming: Restricted vs unrestricted; report unrestricted runway.

items.text: **Plans started.** _How many items in the current plan were due to start in the last three months, and how many actually started?_
items.blockHelp: Eleven counts, one per sphere, for the last three months, answered once per wave by the person who keeps the center's records — not by every resident. items.text: **Live outside contacts.** _How many organizations outside the neighborhood did the center have at least one real exchange with in the last three months?_
items.blockHelp: Eleven counts, one per sphere, for the last three months, answered once per wave by the person who keeps the center's records — not by every resident. items.text: **First-time leads.** _How many people led or initiated something for the first time in the last three months?_

items.text: **Retention.** _Of the people active in the previous three months, how many are still active?_
